tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Max wants to talk about market shopping. what to buy. which shop to visit. when to go.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Max.

promptBlocks.subject: Shopping trip
paragraphs: I am writing about market shopping. what to buy? which shop to visit?
when to go? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Max and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: market shopping
ketImageBrief.panel1: Max starts market shopping with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Max solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
